title: DisplayCaps snapshot
description: The result of one probe. Contains only what the scope asked for.

generation.description: Generation number; increases with each new snapshot from the same probe context.

taken_at_ms.description: When the probe ran, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (capture time for fixtures).

scope.description: The scope that was asked for.

redaction.description: Whether sensitive values have been redacted, and how.

layers.description: System-wide availability of each layer in scope.

endpoints.description: Endpoints in scope, sorted by id.

content.description:
What the application said it intends to show, when it said so (inputs to path reports,
findings and recommendations).

recommendations.description: Recommendations for that content, when the application asked for them.

SnapshotSource.description: What a snapshot was taken from.

oneOf.description: The running system.
A captured fixture tree.

ProbeScope.description:
What a probe may read and report. Build it with [`ProbeScope::nothing`] and the `with_*`
methods, or start from [`ProbeScope::everything`].

presentation_paths.description: Presentation paths to compute effective sets and path reports for.

Selection.description: A selection of items: everything, or only the listed ones. An empty `Only` selects nothing.

oneOf.description: Every item.
Only these items.

External connectors: HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C alt mode, DVI, VGA (also through adapters,
docks and MST hubs; one endpoint per sink).
Internal panels: eDP, LVDS, DSI.
Virtual outputs: VM displays, headless outputs, network streaming, writeback.

Stable endpoint identifier, e.g. `drm:card1-HDMI-A-1`. Stable across probes on the same system

oneOf.description: Every item.

LayerKind.description: The eight layers DisplayCaps reads, from the far end of the cable to the app's sandbox.

oneOf.description: The connected sink and anything between it and the GPU (EDID; DDC/CI and CEC opt-in).
Host hardware: GPU, PCI ids, connector types, link rates the hardware supports.
Kernel driver: driver name, module parameters (e.g. the amdgpu feature mask), kernel.
KMS state read with read-only ioctls: active mode, max bpc, colorspace, HDR metadata, VRR.
The HDMI/DP link, worked out from the layers above (always inferred).
The compositor: HDR, wide colour, image description, VRR policy, scale (Wayland or X11).
Hardware video decode (opt-in): VA-API and Vulkan Video profiles.
Environment: session type, sandbox, permissions, distro, driver sources.

oneOf.description: Every item.

FieldGroup.description: Groups of fields an application can ask for.

oneOf.description: Endpoint identity, names, connector type and correlation keys.
Modes: resolution, refresh, timing, VICs, preferred mode.
Variable refresh rate range and state.
Colour formats (RGB, YCbCr 4:4:4/4:2:2/4:2:0) and bit depths.
HDR: transfer functions, static and dynamic metadata, luminance.
Colorimetry (BT.2020, DCI-P3, xvYCC, ...).
Quantization range (limited or full).

Path reports with hops.

UnknownReason.description: Why a value or layer is unknown.

oneOf.description: A sandbox permission or Snap plug is missing.

`inferred` with a `quirk` source.

oneOf.description: A capability no EDID field carries, e.g. `dolby_vision_low_latency_only`.
The sink's real peak luminance, when the EDID misreports it.
An advertised mode the sink can't actually show.
An HDR format the sink advertises but handles badly, or doesn't advertise but accepts.

supported.description: Whether the sink really accepts it.

oneOf.description: Colorimetry the sink accepts but doesn't advertise.
The EDID is fixed or copied (splitters, extractors), so it describes another device.
A note for diagnostics.

LayerCapabilities.description: One layer's view of an endpoint.

availability.description: Whether the layer could be read.

caps.description: What the layer lets through. Fields outside the probe scope are omitted.

detail.description: State and detail that a capability set can't express, when in scope.

oneOf.description: Host hardware behind the connector.
Kernel driver state.
KMS state of the connector and its CRTC.
The link as worked out from the other layers.
The compositor's view of the output.

Value19.description:
A reported value: either known, with where it came from and how sure we are, or explicitly
unknown with the reason. A layer that can't be read is never reported as "unsupported".

oneOf.description: The value was read or derived.

confidence.description: Measured (read directly) or inferred (derived from tables or quirk data).

provenance.description: Where and when the value was read.

oneOf.description: The value could not be determined.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. the missing permission or the error text.

pci_slot.description: PCI slot, e.g. `0000:03:00.0` (bus topology, not personal).

vendor_name.description: Vendor name from the id table.

gpu.description: The GPU this connector belongs to.

connector_index.description: Connector index on the card for its type, e.g. `1` for `HDMI-A-1`.

CompositorOutput.description: The compositor's view of one output.

output_name.description: The output's name in the compositor, e.g. `HDMI-A-1`.

mode.description: The current mode as the compositor reports it.

wide_color_enabled.description: Wide colour gamut (BT.2020 signalling) switched on.

sdr_brightness_nits.description: SDR content brightness in nits, when HDR is on.

image_description.description: The output's image description (color-management-v1, or the compositor's own API).

rgb_range.description: RGB range setting the compositor applies.

max_bpc.description: Max bits per component the compositor requests.

hdr.description: HDR capabilities as the compositor reports them for the output.

EffectiveSet.description: What survives every layer for one presentation path.

availability.description: Whether the path could be evaluated.

limited_by.description: Which layer limits which field group.

Limit.description: One layer limiting one field group.

PathReport.description: The hops from the application's content to the panel for one presentation path.

content.description:
The content the report was computed for, when the application gave one; otherwise the
report describes the desktop as it is now.

bottleneck.description: Index into `hops` of the bottleneck, if any.

ContentRequest.description: What an application intends to show, for content queries, path reports and recommendations.

bit_depth.description: Bits per component of the content.

frame_rate_millihz.description: Frame rate in millihertz (23.976 fps is `23976`).

needs_chroma.description: Chroma format the content needs on the wire to look right (4:4:4 for desktop text).

Hop.description: One hop in a path report.

rate_kbps.description: Data rate carried, in kbit/s (link hops).

ceiling_kbps.description: Highest data rate this hop can carry, in kbit/s (link hops).

losses.description: What is lost at this hop.

HopKind.description: Kinds of hop, from the content to the panel.

oneOf.description: The application and its content.
The video decoder.
The renderer and tone mapper (what the player renders to).
The compositor (Wayland or X11).
KMS and the kernel driver.
The HDMI/DP link.
The sink.
Devices between the GPU and the display (receiver, splitter, adapter, dock).
The sandbox or session around the app.
The whole path (for findings that are not about one hop).

A reported value: either known, with where it came from and how sure we are, or explicitly

oneOf.description: The value was read or derived.

confidence.description: Measured (read directly) or inferred (derived from tables or quirk data).

provenance.description: Where and when the value was read.

oneOf.description: The value could not be determined.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. the missing permission or the error text.

VideoFormat.description: A picture format at a hop.

rate_millihz.description: Refresh or frame rate in millihertz.

detail.description: Detail, e.g. `10 → 8 bit`.

oneOf.description: Resolution reduced or scaled.
Refresh doesn't match the content, or is lower than asked.
Bits per component reduced.
Chroma subsampled (4:2:2 or 4:2:0).
Quantization range changed or mismatched.
HDR tone-mapped to SDR.
Dynamic HDR (Dolby Vision, HDR10+) dropped to static.
Wide gamut mapped to a smaller one.
Variable refresh not used.
Hardware decode not available.

FindingCode.description:
Stable finding code, e.g. `HDR_AVAILABLE_NOT_ENABLED`. Codes come from rule packs, so this is a
string rather than a closed enum; codes are never reused for a different meaning.

Recommendation.description:
A recommendation for content on a path. DisplayCaps returns it; the app or the compositor
applies it. DisplayCaps never changes a mode or setting.

presentation_path.description: The presentation path it is for.

mode.description: The mode to switch to (a mode the sink lists).

color_format.description: Colour format the link would carry.

bit_depth.description: Bits per component the link would carry.

hdr.description: HDR format to render for, `None` to render SDR.

target_peak_nits.description: Peak luminance to tone-map to, in nits.

compromises.description: What the recommendation gives up, if anything.

endpoint.description: The endpoint it concerns, if any.

presentation_path.description: The presentation path it concerns, if any.

confidence.description: How sure the finding is.

oneOf.description: Informational.
Quality or features are lost.
The path doesn't work as the app expects.

Evidence.description: One evidence value behind a finding.

provenance.description: Where it came from.

Hint.description: A remediation hint, keyed by distro family and, for display findings, by compositor.

distro_family.description: The distro family the hint was written for; `None` for the generic fallback.

compositor.description: The compositor the hint was written for; `None` when it applies to any compositor.
